description: Remediates deferred CLAUDE-AUTH-011 risk: local model config save path was inside the repo with no allowlist or dangerous-root denylist. Adds scripts/ide/config_root_allowlist.py::verify(requested_root, allowed_parents=...) that refuses (1) None/empty/NUL paths (BLOCKED_MALFORMED_PATH); (2) any input containing '..' segments (BLOCKED_PATH_TRAVERSAL); (3) resolved paths matching the dangerous-root denylist (POSIX: /, /etc, /usr, /bin, /sbin, /boot, /sys, /proc, /dev, /root, /var, /lib, /lib64, /System, /Library; Windows: C:\, C:\Windows, C:\Program Files, C:\Program Files (x86), C:\ProgramData) (BLOCKED_DISALLOWED_ROOT); (4) resolved paths NOT inside any caller-supplied allowed_parents (BLOCKED_UNTRUSTED_CONFIG). Empty allowed_parents refuses everything. Verifier never creates the directory; never opens source_mutation or training.
